purpose: Exploratory validation-only alert suppression trade-off, not an independently assessed or deployable policy
rule: Keep the highest-logit attack category only when its margin is strictly greater than a nonnegative threshold; otherwise predict Benign
threshold_selection: Smallest nonnegative observed benign-score cutoff permitting at most floor(budget * benign_count) false alerts, with strict greater-than ties
limits: No new model, architecture, score family, class-specific threshold search or fitted probability calibration
All twelve neural checkpoints and original argmax evaluations must verify before selecting any threshold
Thresholds use only benign validation scores; report every budget and seed, not a chosen winning threshold
Empirical same-validation false-alert caps are by construction, not out-of-sample guarantees
The gate can suppress alerts but cannot recover or relabel missed attack categories
Softmax outputs are uncalibrated scores, not established probabilities of real-world attacks
Feature matrices and saved scores are disk-backed; no test or training arrays are needed
Tree weights were not saved in the prior stage; no tree is refitted in this diagnostic
